## Data and Software

- Dolinsky, Alona, Lena Maria Huber and Will Horne, Parties’ Social Group Appeals (PSoGA) Database: group appeals coded at the sentence level in 791 election manifestos from 139 parties in eight European countries, 1970–2025
- Dolinsky, Alona, Lena Maria Huber and Will Horne, “ManifestoVault V1.0: Annotated full-text general election manifestos at the natural-sentence level”, DataverseNL ([doi:10.34894/VKQSPO](https://doi.org/10.34894/VKQSPO))
- Dolinsky, Alona, Lena Maria Huber and Will Horne, `groupappeals`: Python package for detecting and classifying group appeals in political texts ([GitHub](https://github.com/alonadoli/GroupAppeals))
